contract: README.md: static preview of a fixed 720x540 Finder content layout; real app left, Applications link right, English instructions and existing product icon. This record validates artwork preview only.

accessibility.evidence: Browser accessibility tree exposes the full installation, conditional first-launch commands and signature prerequisite. The copyable instructions link has visible keyboard focus. Decorative icons are hidden; no animation or keyboard traps. Native Finder keyboard and dark-mode behavior remain untested on Windows.

responsive.evidence: Inspected both screenshots. The desktop preview shows the full fixed layout; the narrow preview scales the composition proportionally and wraps its explanatory note without horizontal overflow. The native installer is a desktop Finder window, not a mobile interface.

loading.reason: Static local artwork; both preview images finished loading in the observed browser state. No application loading UI.

empty.reason: The static preview always depicts exactly two items and has no data-dependent empty state.

error.reason: Preview cannot copy files. Real copy errors belong to Finder and need target-Mac validation.

partial.reason: There is no asynchronous content or partial-result state in this static design.

success.reason: Preview does not perform an installation or claim success. Finder owns copy completion in the real DMG.

permission.reason: Static preview requests no permission. Finder and Gatekeeper prompts remain native and untested here.

renderedEvidence.observation: Full desktop layout inspected: two icons and arrow aligned, English instructions and signature/quarantine command chain readable, separate copyable-instructions link visible.
Whole composition scales without clipping or horizontal overflow; explanatory preview note remains readable. This is a layout overview, not mobile installation UI.

nativeValidation.reason: Current host is Windows. macOS DMG build, mount, stored layout verification, real Finder rendering, drag/copy, keyboard operation and Gatekeeper acceptance must run on macOS. CI packaging checks and target-Mac instructions are included.
